decision_cruda.rationale: LH-03 failure at C590-07 confirmed by radio and CMMS, with no disagreement. The repair is in place, likely done by 09:54 and at the latest 10:00. A loan would need travel time and would arrive about when the repair finishes. The only lender candidate in Central is LH-09 on a development heading worth 1.5 oz/h, so the loan would cost development value. Central is also near truck capacity (inflow 83 against 91 t/h). The stope has 323 t and will not run out before 17:00, so the lost loading time is small and can be made up after the repair. No move.

LH-03 is down until about 15:30 (range 14:30–17:30), and radio and CMMS agree, so no confirmation is needed. C590-07 holds 323 t at 8.4 g/t, about 87 oz. Central's trucks (91 t/h) are only slightly below the loader inflow (83 t/h), and its stockpile has room. Lending LH-08 (LH410, 25.4 t/h) from the cheaper heading (1.0 oz/h) costs about 0.67 h of travel. That leaves about 5.8 h of loading, roughly 147 t or 40 oz, against about 7 oz of development lost, for about 33 oz net. LH-09 gives about the same net (shorter 0.35 h trip, but 1.5 oz/h development cost), so I picked LH-08. No loader is freed from a stopped stope, so no reserve is activated. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 12:00.
